hypotheses.justification: The theorem already has h : FCHyp L K n φ t, whose Setup field card_K says Nat.card K = 2 ^ n (Setup in SteinbergSFCentralInvolutionFusion.lean). Hence Nat.card K ≠ 0 and Finite K follows from h via Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero. The statement does not need Finite K to elaborate: FCHyp, Setup and the notations (pull, rootU/rootA, pCore, closure) need only Group G, Field K, CharP K 2 and Finite G (Finite G is needed by CFSG.pCore, so it stays). The file already has other declarations with `omit [Finite K] in` that use the same notations (e.g. torus_le_N, torus_le_Y). The proof only needs a first line `haveI : Finite K := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [h.setup.card_K]; positivity)`, after which exists_M_eq_dSub and dSub_inf_E0 (which take [Finite K]) apply unchanged. So the theorem remains true and provable with `omit [Finite K] in`.
